hook: Tests, oral answers and procedures — in one app?
intro: NurseGuide is a study app for nurses and mid-level medical staff.
daily: Five new questions every day, with an explanation and a source after each answer.
hub: Tests, oral tickets and work on your mistakes, all in one section.
test: Choose your direction: exam mode with a timer, or practice mode with an instant answer.
oral: Draw a ticket and check yourself against the answer plan.
procedures: Step-by-step guides, each with its source.
workplace: Pick your direction: nursing, midwifery, patronage, X-ray laboratory and more.
groups: Teachers create groups, assign tests and see the results.
sources: Every item shows where it comes from.
languages: The interface is in Uzbek, Russian and English.
